note: Raw (uncorrected p<0.05) significance audit of the 1126-cell quoting grid, to support leading the null on raw effect sizes rather than on BH/BHY (which is permutation-floor-bound). The Avellaneda-Stoikov inventory-skew family (M1) has 0 raw-significant cells before any correction. The only raw-significant cells are zero-magnitude spread diagnostics (M6 realised spread, ~1e-5 bp) or gross / pre-cost quantities (M6 zero-fee skill; M3 microprice/integrated-OFI gross signals) that the cost-frontier analysis kills (the OFI signal turns from +0.11 bp gross to -1.30 bp net).
